subject: Your M0 asks under the new Profile v2
body: leverage stays (optional per state). ownWords is state.words, and memoryCue is a private cue only. The triad slots are gone: you append strategy steps as elicited, so there are no empty slots. Unreached sections are null, and strategy.confirmed=false until the 1.6 playback. The anchor is now anchorStep (an index) plus optional anchorDetail on that step. Calibration summary per state: calibration.peak and calibration.contrast, including your 0-10 rating. onboarding.run() returns {status:'confirmed', profile} or {status:'stopped', reason:'safety'|'cancel', draft}. One thing I need: can the voice flow fill every field in contracts/PLAN.md? Flag any it can't.
